headline: Need Heavy Equipment? Rent Fast on the App
subheadline: Hire verified JCBs, Cranes, and Excavators in minutes. Zero down payment, experienced operators included, and guaranteed replacement if work ever stops.

faqs.question: How fast can machines reach my construction site?
faqs.answer: In city areas, equipment reaches your site in 2 to 4 hours. For regional or highway sites, transport trailers deliver within 6 to 12 hours. You can track your machine live on the mobile app from yard to site gate.

faqs.question: What is included in the rental price? Are there hidden charges?
faqs.answer: No hidden charges. Your price includes the machine, a certified operator, and free routine maintenance. Diesel can be included or supplied by you. You see the final transparent price before you book in the app.

faqs.question: What happens if a machine stops working on site?
faqs.answer: A mobile service team reaches your site within 3 hours. If it cannot be repaired on the spot, we dispatch a replacement machine at zero extra delivery charge. Your billing automatically freezes while the machine is paused.

faqs.question: How quickly do I get my security deposit back?
faqs.answer: Your deposit is kept safe in digital escrow. The moment your project finishes, the remaining balance is sent back directly to your bank account or UPI within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Can I extend my rental if the project needs more time?
faqs.answer: Yes! Just tap 'Extend' in the BookMyEquipment mobile app anytime. Your machine stays on site working without any delay.

faqs.question: Are the machine operators trained and licensed?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every operator has a valid heavy vehicle license, passed background checks, and brings at least 3 years of hands-on site experience.

faqs.question: Do I get a proper GST tax invoice for my company?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every completed booking automatically generates a GST commercial tax invoice so your company gets full input tax credit.
